subject: Sierra Systems — commitment schedule & stakeholder risks
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@sierra-systems.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@sierra-systems.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & proposed commitment schedule (post-call)

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view. I focused this on milestones that align to the procurement and security gates you mentioned.

Key pain & goals we captured:
- Current latency and unpredictability on your inference endpoints is causing frequent timeouts in production and a poor UX for your agents.
- Unit cost per token is spiking during peak batch jobs; finance needs a clearer run-rate to justify a 2027 budget increase.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and VPC isolation are hard requirements for any vendor.

Proposed commitment schedule (first pass):
1) 2026-09-07: Demo with infra + security (live within our VPC diagram) — owners: Ben (Redwood), Priya (Sierra)
2) 2026-09-14: Security questionnaire & evidence exchange (SOC2 snapshot, network diagram) — owners: Grace (Redwood), Priya (Sierra)
3) 2026-09-28: Pilot kickoff (2-week controlled run on dedicated capacity) — owners: Ben (Redwood), Sam (Sierra)
4) 2026-10-12: Pilot review + cost/latency metrics and decision meeting — owners: Avery (Redwood), Sam (Sierra)

Open risks / assumptions:
- We assume access to a representative workload (sample request traces + typical sequence lengths) before the pilot starts.
- Pricing shown in the attached estimate is indicative; final terms depend on committed capacity and retention requirements.
- SOC2 evidence will require a short turnaround from Sierra security to avoid schedule slippage.

Attachments: Sierra_MPA_v1.xlsx (commitment schedule + owners), pricing_estimate_sierra_v2.pdf (ballpark pricing)

Requests / next steps for Sierra:
- Please confirm owners for the security questionnaire and the pilot environment by EOD Thu 8/26.
- If those dates don't work, propose alternate dates and indicate any blackout windows for your infra team.

I'll coordinate calendars for the demo once we lock in the security owners.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Avery — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns to what we heard internally. A few notes:

- Pilot window looks good; only ask is to push the demo one day earlier if possible (9/6 instead of 9/7) because our infra lead is out on the 7th.
